protocol.authorization: Vinh explicitly requested continuing Q4 window/fusion development experiment. No production/default/gold promotion.
protocol.candidates: Exactly frozen Q3 body-embedding Hybrid top20, SQL authorized per original tenant; all20 retained in every arm.

arms.H: Original frozen hybrid order; no rerank
arms.R: Current pinned MiniLM body-only rerank, actual truncation unchanged
arms.W: Reuse R scores for fitting passages. For truncated passages, retain original-prefix R score and score additional overlapping sentence-aware tail windows; max over prefix/tail scores.
arms.FW: Equal-weight rank RRF(H,W), k=60; secondary combined treatment

window_policy.first_window: Reuse the actual current truncated-prefix score and its tokenizer-visible character ranges.
window_policy.query_budget: min(384, actual model pair limit minus query tokens minus tokenizer pair-special tokens)
window_policy.sentence_end: Prefer last sentence boundary within budget if it keeps at least half the budget; otherwise token boundary. If remaining tail fits, retain all.
window_policy.character_slices: Offsets from actual pinned fast tokenizer; original body substrings only, no heading/paraphrase.
window_policy.retokenization: Shrink end if necessary; verify no extra tail window is truncated by actual model preprocessing.
window_policy.coverage: Every original document token must be visible in the prefix or at least one tail window. No maximum window-count cap.
window_policy.aggregation: Maximum raw cross-encoder score across retained prefix and tail windows per original passage. Short/fitting passage scores remain exactly R.
window_policy.tie_break: Lower original UUID, matching canonical rank_scores/rrf_fuse.
window_policy.word_boundary_alignment: Target overlap64 is extended backward when needed to avoid starting inside an original tokenizer word.

primary_tests: W minus R MRR on AI-v3 primary/direct-source labels
F minus R MRR on same labels
protocol.acceptance: Support a replacement only if primary paired MRR lower CI >0, mean P@5 does not decrease, frozen membership/Recall20 and SQL authorization invariants pass. To argue reranking replaces H, additionally require positive paired MRR lower CI vs H and disclose added latency. No default promotion in this task.

statistics.CI: 95% percentile paired query bootstrap; two unadjusted exploratory primary tests; no label-error uncertainty modeled

protocol.sufficiency: Reuse only exact previously judged top5 sets; new sets remain null; do not average a selectively judged subset as all32.
protocol.window_multiple_chances: Max aggregation can favor long passages; this fixed tradeoff is measured, not tuned after outcomes.
protocol.latency: R inference warmup excluded. W cost is actual R prefix pass plus tail-window processing. Fusion adds only rank-merge work. Retrieval latency is excluded; no clean-machine speedup claim.
protocol.isolation: Read-only DB export; offline single local MiniLM worker through existing embedder provider implementation. Main corpus fingerprint verified before/after. No indexing, re-embedding, candidate changes or held-out use.
protocol.label_status: AI v3, not independent human validation; Q1/Q2/Q3/Q4 review/commit/CI gates remain pending.
